question: List one material agreement or other exhibit number explicitly identified in the Exhibit Index (e.g., "Exhibit 10.1: Credit Agreement")—or record "none listed" if no material agreements are identified.
rationale: The coverage cache was absent, so I used rule inspection plus single-rule verifies to estimate empirical coverage and to narrow the search to the three long-form exhibit-section rules. Exhausting the meaningful combinations showed the two generic table rules were the best verified subset at 0.2 match rate while staying below half of the full-pool cost. The hard constraint was not satisfiable under the required `all_labeled` verification target in this environment; early-8K and short-doc fallback rules never fired on the ten labeled docs, so they could not improve accuracy.
